title: Product with a conjugate character
statement: Let $G$ be an additive commutative group, let $\phi,\chi:G\to\mathbb C$ be additive characters, and let $x\in G$. Their product character, formed from $\phi$ and the conjugate character associated with $\chi$, takes the value $\phi(x)\overline{\chi(x)}$ at $x$.
hypotheses_covered: $\phi$ and $\chi$ are additive characters from $G$ to $\mathbb C$
